name: Gehazi
summary: The servant of Elisha, who helped him care for a woman of Shunem and her son. When he lied to get silver from Naaman, Naaman's leprosy came on him.

key_moments.title: Points Out the Woman Has No Son
key_moments.description: Elisha asked how to repay a woman of Shunem for her kindness. Gehazi pointed out that she had no son and her husband was old, and Elisha promised her a son.

key_moments.title: Lays the Staff on the Dead Boy
key_moments.description: When the woman's son died, Elisha sent Gehazi ahead to lay his staff on the boy's face, but the child did not wake. Then Elisha came and prayed, and Gehazi called the mother in to take up her son.

key_moments.title: Running After Naaman
key_moments.description: Gehazi ran after Naaman and lied to get silver and clothes, then told Elisha he had gone nowhere. Elisha said Naaman's leprosy would cling to him, and Gehazi left with leprosy, white as snow.

key_moments.title: Tells the King of Elisha's Deeds
key_moments.description: Gehazi was describing Elisha's great deeds to the king just as the Shunammite woman came to plead for her home and land. The king had everything that was hers given back to her.
